jobs.occupation: Product Manager, data & AI – SitaWare Insight
jobs.description:
Product Manager, data & AI – SitaWare Insight

What if your operational experience could shape the data and AI capabilities behind better decisions in the battlefield? Join SitaWare Insight as Product Manager, and turn real-world defence and intelligence needs into product features, compelling customer demonstrations and meaningful improvements for soldiers, staff officers and NATO customers.

The job

As Product Manager for SitaWare Insight, you will work alongside our Business Product Manager and development teams to turn operational needs into concrete product features. You will be the voice of the customer and end-user, guiding the team’s day-to-day work and helping us to show what our data and AI platform can do for command and control (C2).

In short, you can look forward to:

• guiding the development team’s day-to-day work, translating operational requirements into concrete features for SitaWare Insight

• representing the voice of the customer and end-user, including prioritising fixes and change requests through our change control boards

• using Insight’s own toolset – dashboards, data import and agents – to build examples that show customers and colleagues what is possible

• supporting the sales team with product expertise, customer visits and proposal input while helping the marketing department to create product collateral

• representing Systematic at conferences, trade shows and user forums, and presenting to customers on-site

The position requires regular international travel to customers and Systematic offices, approximately 20–30 days each year.

Joining the team

Based in Copenhagen, you will be close to the development teams building SitaWare Insight, while collaborating closely with Product Management colleagues in Aarhus. Alongside our Business Product Manager, who owns the product roadmap, you will provide operational input for the team’s daily implementation and help keep development aligned with user needs and product priorities. Together, you will be part of a collaborative team committed to turning data and AI into solutions that make a tangible difference across the defence sector from staff at headquarters to decision-makers in the field.

Your qualifications

You bring a solid background from the armed forces or intelligence services – for example as an officer, NCO or in a role such as an information manager – or several years of hands-on experience working directly with defence or intelligence customers as a supplier of data or information products or systems. This operational experience is essential, as it enables you to understand the realities our end-users face and to translate their needs into concrete product decisions.

We are also looking for:

• a genuine interest in how data and AI support C2, and the ability to translate this into product direction. You do not need to be able to write code, but you must be able to engage confidently in technical dialogue with data engineers and architects

• excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate confidently and effectively in English

• confidence in presenting to larger audiences, for example at customer visits, conferences or user forums

• an independent, structured work style with the ability to prioritise your own work and influence cross-functional teams without formal authority

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

Welcome to Systematic Copenhagen

When you join us in Copenhagen, you are not just getting a desk at one of the city’s best locations – you are stepping into a workplace where community matters. Our Employees Club keeps things lively with monthly social events, and our office catering ensures you are always well taken care of. And whether you are into casual games or just good company, you will find both at our foosball table or during our relaxed Friday bar gatherings.

Never stop developing

Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1,200 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most – this is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. Systematic is not just a place to work but a place to belong.

Start your development here

We will be assessing applications on an ongoing basis as we wish to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible, so click Apply Now and send us your CV today.

If you have any questions, you are always welcome to contact us on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Hans Jørgen Bohlbro, Vice President, Product Management.

jobs.occupation: Senior Incident Response Security Consultant, Mandiant, Google Cloud (English)
jobs.description:
Google welcomes people with disabilities.

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:

**Remote locations: Italy; Denmark.****Minimum qualifications:

**

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 5 years of experience working end-to-end incident response investigations, analysis, or containment actions.

• 5 years of investigative experience with network forensics, malware triage analysis, cloud forensics, or disk and memory forensics.

• Ability to communicate in English fluently to work with internal partners and customer teams.

• Ability to travel up to 30% of the time.

**Preferred qualifications:

**

• Certifications in cloud platforms.

• Experience in security competitions, Capture the Flags (CTFs) or testing platforms such as Hack the Box, TryHackMe, Overthewire, etc.

• Ability to communicate investigative findings and strategies to technical staff, executive leadership, legal counsel, and internal and external clients.

• Excellent time and project management skills.

**About The Job

**As a Senior Incident Response Security Consultant, you will provide industry-leading incident response, assessment, transformation, managed detection and response, and training services with in-depth tactical support. You will help organizations effectively detect and respond to threats and reduce the overall impact of business risk before, during, and after an incident. You will be able to resolve security incidents quickly, effectively and at scale with complete incident response including investigation, containment, remediation, and crisis management. In this role, you will work on engagements including assisting clients in navigating technically complex and high-profile incidents, performing forensic analysis, threat hunting, and malware triage.

Part of Google Cloud, Mandiant is a recognized leader in dynamic cyber defense, threat intelligence and incident response services. Mandiant's cybersecurity expertise has earned the trust of security professionals and company executives around the world. Our unique combination of renowned frontline experience responding to some of the most complex breaches, nation-state grade threat intelligence, machine intelligence, and the industry's best security validation ensures that Mandiant knows more about today's advanced threats than anyone.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Denmark: kr.960000 - kr.980000 (DKK) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Italy: €88000 - €90000 (EUR) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

**Responsibilities

**Learn more about benefits at Google .

• Collaborate with internal and customer teams to investigate and contain incidents.

• Recognize and codify attacker tools, tactics, and procedures (TTPs) and indicators of compromise (IOCs) that can be applied to current and future investigations.

• Conduct host forensics, network forensics, log analysis, and malware triage in support of incident response investigations.

jobs.occupation: FP&A Analyst or Senior Analyst, Strategic Finance
jobs.description:
Do you know your way around a balance sheet and a liquidity forecast, and not just the P&L? We are looking for an FP&A Analyst or Senior Analyst to join our Strategic Finance team in Hobro.

Who we are

Eurowind Energy is a global and leading developer, owner and operator of energy parks. Based in Denmark, we operate in 16 countries around Europe and in the USA, and we are continuously growing our project portfolio. We believe in a future of renewable energy, and we have an ambitious plan of becoming the next generation's "Power Major". Based on a full value chain from greenfield project development to energy trading, more than 700 team members are dedicated to creating a greener future fueled with nothing but renewable energy!

We are looking for an experienced FP&A Analyst or Senior Analyst to join our Strategic Finance team in Hobro, Denmark. Based at our headquarters, you will be part of a team of three that provides financial planning, forecasting and analysis across the entire organisation. Strategic Finance is a small function within the CFO area, operating at group level in close collaboration with Group Finance and the business. We do not sit in project or asset controlling.

Your role

You will join a team of three in Strategic Finance. Modelling takes up the largest share of the week, closely followed by understanding how projects, assets and operations flow into the numbers. Collecting, reconciling and reviewing data, and turning it all into analysis, make up the rest.

This is a newly created position, as we are growing the team to match the scope ahead. There is no finished set of models to take over. You will help build them.

With Blackstone Infrastructure set to become a co-owner of Eurowind Energy, Strategic Finance expects to play a growing part in the financial planning and reporting that goes to our owners. Over time, you will work directly with reporting and analysis prepared for one of the world's largest infrastructure investors.

• Budgeting, forecasting and long term financial planning, with an emphasis on balance sheet modelling and liquidity forecasting

• Designing, building and developing integrated financial models (P&L, balance sheet and cash flow) at group, portfolio and project level

• Scenario and sensitivity analysis on liquidity, financing and portfolio development

• Monthly and quarterly management reporting and variance analysis

• Preparing presentations for the board and senior management

• Building and maintaining data pipelines and reconciliations between our ERP and our models

• Developing new reporting tools and dashboards, e.g. in Power BI, and shaping the processes behind them

You will also work with department heads and regional leads when the analysis calls for it, but business partnering is not the main focus. The core of the role is the modelling, the data and the analysis that sit behind the decisions.

What we offer

Strategic Finance sits close to the centre of the organisation, and the models built here are used for real decisions.

• Real influence on how our financial models and processes are built. Not just maintaining what exists, but shaping the structure, logic and methods behind them

• A say in how work is organised, from data flows to reporting cadence, in a team that is still taking shape

• Data from across the entire organisation, from development and construction to operations and offtake

• Room to improve how data flows into planning, reporting and analysis

• Close sparring, clear priorities and colleagues who are involved in the work

• Direct exposure to senior management and, over time, to owner level reporting

Required competencies and skills

We are looking for someone with 1 to 5 years of relevant experience. Whether you join as Analyst or Senior Analyst depends on your experience and how the match feels on both sides. The scope and the team are the same.

• A degree in finance, economics, business or a related field

• Experience in FP&A, controlling, consulting or a similar analytical role

• Solid understanding of balance sheet dynamics and liquidity forecasting

• Advanced Excel and financial modelling skills

• Experience working with data from ERP systems

• Experience with Power BI or similar reporting tools

• Curiosity about how the business works. You want to understand what drives the numbers, not just report them

• Structured and precise, comfortable with deadlines and shifting priorities

• Knowledge of the energy sector is an advantage

Please note that this role requires a clean criminal record.

Renewable energy is our future. And so are our people!

At Eurowind Energy we do our best to create a culture where everyone is valued and feels at home. You will notice this in your everyday work life, where you have the freedom to speak up and where your voice means something to us. We know that when you grow, we grow. Therefore, we strive to support you in what you believe is right and in your personal and professional development. We offer you an exciting job in an energetic and international environment. And we promise you: the wind is never standing still.

Developing, operating and managing wind and solar parks is not just pure business for us. It is a way to view the world. And with this worldview comes a genuine ambition to be one of the leading developers in Europe. Because creating a future run entirely on green energy matters to us.

We manage our own portfolio of projects and at the same time, we perform technical and financial management of projects. We have throughout many years experienced sustained economic growth in the number of developed projects and companies in management. And we continue to expect this. Simply because it is in our nature to keep developing – projects, companies and our people.

Did we capture your attention?

Great! If you see yourself in this role, do not hesitate to apply for the position. Please use the link below. As we continuously review incoming applications, please send us your CV and a brief cover letter as soon as possible. In the letter, tell us who you are and, in a few concrete examples, what you have actually delivered in your career so far, such as models you have built, processes you have improved or analyses that changed a decision.

Should you have any questions before applying, please feel free to contact Jeppe Falk Hansen, Lead Specialist, Strategic Finance & Insights, at jfh@ewe.dk.

We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis

Read more about Eurowind Energy on our website or LinkedIn

Application deadline:

As soon as possible

Vattenfall’s Operational Control Centre is a central part of our Business Unit Wind, Offshore, Generation. We monitor more than 1,500 wind turbines and provide support to all Vattenfall sites Onshore and Offshore within turbine monitoring, high-voltage control, and marine coordination – 24/7, all year round. Our goal is to ensure high availability and safe operations, enabling us to accelerate the transition to a fossil-free society together.

Your Tasks

As a Control Centre Operator, you will be a key person in the operation of our wind assets.

You will be responsible for:

• Monitoring and optimizing wind turbines and transformer stations in real time

• Responding quickly to alarms and unforeseen errors to minimize downtime

• Planning and performing switching operations under Wind Electrical Safety Rules (WESR)

• Handling permits and ensuring proper return to normal operation after maintenance or incidents

• Ensuring open communication with internal teams and external authorities – both in daily operations and during critical incidents

• Preparing precise operational reports and contributing to the coordination of grid balance

• Identifying and sharing opportunities for process improvements across the organization

Qualifications

We are looking for someone who:

• Has a technical education as an electrician, wind turbine technician, or similar

• Has experience with electrical systems or wind turbine operations – experience from a control room is an advantage

• Thrives with shift work and being able to keep your head cool under pressure

• Has good IT skills and can navigate digital systems confidently

• Speaks and writes fluent Danish and English

• Has a strong safety focus and works systematically and collaboratively

• Can make independent decisions and communicate clearly with colleagues and partners

Additional Information

• Workplace: Esbjerg, Denmark. You must live within daily transport distance.

• All high-voltage tasks must be performed in accordance with applicable legislation.

• Security clearance from the Danish Energy Agency is required for this position.

Our offer

We can offer you the opportunity to make a real world difference whilst shaping your own working environment and career. We provide a competitive salary and benefits package, a progressive, inclusive culture, and the chance to work with some of the best in the industry. You will play a vital role within interdisciplinary teams and you can always count on support from committed colleagues; our ‘Ask and Share’ concept is embedded in the way we work. We also offer attractive employment conditions and opportunities for personal and professional development.

Process and timeline

Please submit your application in English or Danish via our website. We do not accept applications in other ways.

We review applications and conduct interviews continuously, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. The job posting will be closed once we have found the ideal candidate.

For more information about the position, please contact Martin Jul Tromborg on +45 27875466.

For more information about the recruitment process, please contact Senior Recruiter Jette Ingeberg on +45 22 57 07 51

At Vattenfall we believe that diversity contributes to a more attractive and successful company and we strive to be a role model for diversity. Vattenfall works actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, transgender identity or expression, religion or other belief, disability or sexual orientation.

The security of Vattenfall and its employees is essential. For that reason, a pre-employment screening will be part of your recruitment process. The screening is based on the role you will fulfil within Vattenfall and will be performed by a third party, DISA Global Solutions AB.

Since Vattenfall is a part of the Swedish critical infrastructure, many of our services are security classed. If this position is security classified the final candidates might be subject to a security vetting process, according to Swedish legislation.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Company Description

Vattenfall is a European energy company with approximately 21 000 employees. For more than 100 years we have electrified industries, supplied energy to people’s homes and modernized our way of living through innovation and cooperation. We are looking for talented individuals who, in addition to their passion for their own role, also have strong team spirit and want to contribute to supporting a meaningful corporate mission.

Business Area Wind is responsible for Vattenfall’s Onshore and Offshore Wind as well as other non-hydro Renewable activities like solar PV and batteries. Today we develop, construct and operate wind generation in Sweden, Denmark, Germany, the Netherlands and the UK. In addition, we have a clear strategy to develop our solar PV and battery operations further.

Job Description

Would you like to shape Denmark’s pension solutions of tomorrow? As our new Consultant, you’ll use your actuarial expertise to turn complex models and business logic into tangible solutions, creating value for clients and society. Join a major IT project and turn theory into practice.

Responsibilities

As a Consultant within the life and pensions industry, you will become part of a specialised team contributing to the development of a new, unified IT system for pension solutions in Denmark.

You will work at the intersection of deep expertise in actuarial mathematics and technical implementation in a dynamic, and ambitious environment. Your expertise will be at the heart of our work, and you will see your analyses, business insights, and models create direct value for our clients and their businesses. Your work will involve developing and implementing complex calculation models and ensuring that solutions meet both business and regulatory requirements.

In addition, you will gain broad insight into different companies within the pensions industry and develop expertise in delivering large-scale IT projects. You will work closely with actuaries and pension experts at our clients and contribute to building actuarial and pension-specific capabilities at Netcompany.

Your responsibilities will typically include:

• 
Developing and implementing calculation models for life and pension products.

• 
Quality assurance and testing of pension products, as well as bridging the gap between actuarial expertise and technical implementation.

• 
Ensuring that solutions comply with applicable legislation and standards.

• 
Communicating complex analyses and results to colleagues, developers, testers, and clients.

• 
Contributing to the design and customisation of insurance and pension products within our solutions.

About you

• 
You are a recent graduate or have a few years of relevant professional experience within actuarial mathematics.

• 
You hold a Master’s degree in actuarial science (cand.act.) or a similar relevant degree that has given you a strong academic foundation and a logical approach to handling large datasets and advanced models.

• 
You thrive in a dynamic environment focused on collaboration and continuous personal and professional development.

• 
Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

We provide a structured career model that allows you to build on your existing experiences.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will support your development and help you achieve your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in management gives you concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and desires.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars tailored to you and where you are in your career. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills. Participating alongside colleagues from across the company helps you build a solid network and provides a strong foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritize an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand your network.

Send us an application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

WHO WE ARE

At Maersk, we are building enterprise-scale data and AI platforms to power intelligent, integrated supply chain solutions. Our ambition is to enable real-time visibility, AI-driven automation, and seamless data access across the business through a unified platform approach. We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to join us in this journey.

As a Senior Engineering Manager for AI & Data Platform, you will lead one or more engineering teams responsible for delivering scalable data platforms and AI-enabled capabilities. You will drive execution across data engineering, platform development, and agentic AI enablement, ensuring solutions are aligned to enterprise strategy and deliver measurable business outcomes. The role is accountable for delivery, engineering quality, team capability, and platform reliability rather than purely strategy definition.

Key Responsibilities:

1. AI & Data Platform Delivery

• Lead delivery of data platforms, data products, and AI-enabled applications supporting enterprise use cases

• Enable agentic AI adoption, ensuring data pipelines and platforms support AI-driven workflows and decisioning

• Drive development of integrated data foundations to support end-to-end visibility across systems

2. Data & Analytics Enablement

• Enable democratised data access through governed, queryable data layers (decoupled from operational systems)

• Drive self-service reporting and dashboards, reducing reliance on central teams

• Ensure high-quality, reliable, and secure data foundations for analytics and AI

3. Platform Engineering & Architecture Alignment

• Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture, platform, and cloud strategies

• Drive adoption of reusable platform components and engineering standards

• Support integration across SAP and non-SAP ecosystems

4. Engineering Leadership & Team Delivery

• Lead and develop high-performing engineering teams across data, platform, and AI domains

• Own delivery outcomes, quality standards, and engineering practices within teams

• Drive Agile execution, prioritization, and alignment with product and business stakeholders

5. Operational Excellence & Scalability

• Ensure solutions are designed for scalability, reliability, and performance at global scale

We are building an AI-powered operating model for Ocean Operations and a next-generation optimisation capability for global Network Design. This role is not limited to agent orchestration or execution workflows. It is a senior technical leadership role for how AI strengthens optimisation methods, modelling, and decision quality across both planning and execution.

The remit is broader than a standalone AI feature set. It covers how AI, optimisation, and engineering come together to deliver better network decisions at scale, while also shaping agentic decision systems in Control Tower style execution environments.

Role purpose:

The Principal AI Engineer will set the technical direction for AI-augmented optimisation and intelligent operational decisioning. This person will lead through specialists in optimisation, modelling, heuristics, analytics, and experimentation. They will define where AI can materially improve search, structural recommendations, and solver-backed workflows, while also guiding the design of multi-agent systems for reasoning, orchestration, exception handling, and human-in-the-loop execution.

What you will own?

•Technical direction for AI-augmented optimisation and agentic decision systems across Network Design and operational execution

•How planning problems are framed and where AI can improve search, candidate generation, structural recommendations, and decision quality

•The interface between AI systems, heuristics, solver layers, optimisation services, and enterprise workflows

•Patterns for when AI should recommend, act autonomously, or escalate to humans

•The quality bar for experimentation, evaluation, and translation of new methods into measurable value for planners and decision-makers

•Reusable intelligence patterns that can scale across both Control Tower and Network Design use cases

Key responsibilities:

•Lead the optimisation intelligence agenda across network design, routing, vessel deployment, cargo flow, and operational decisioning

•Set direction for how teams define problem structures, formulate optimisation approaches, design heuristics, and identify where AI can improve search, modelling quality, and decision outcomes

•Guide specialists building optimisation models, analytical components, and AI capabilities, ensuring their work fits into a coherent AI plus OR architecture

•Drive structured experimentation to compare alternative methods, validate model behaviour, and improve performance, robustness, and scalability

•Define how AI systems should interact with solver layers, heuristics, and optimisation services rather than treating AI as a separate layer

•Lead the use of agentic AI where it adds value to reasoning, orchestration, exception handling, and human-in-the-loop decision support

•Shape the innovation roadmap by identifying promising new methods and accelerating them into pilots and scaled capabilities

•Raise standards across modelling practice, technical quality, experimentation discipline, and architectural judgment

•Communicate assumptions, trade-offs, and limitations clearly to senior stakeholders and decision-makers

What we are looking for?

We are looking for a senior technical leader with deep credibility across both AI and optimisation, and with the ability to lead through highly skilled specialists rather than doing all modelling work personally.

The strongest profile will combine experience in agentic AI systems and human-in-the-loop workflows with strong grounding in optimisation methods such as heuristics, search, mathematical programming, decomposition, or hybrid AI plus OR approaches. This person should also be comfortable directing teams working on modelling, experimentation, performance improvement, and implementation into production environments.

Required qualifications:

•Advanced degree in engineering, mathematics, computer science, operations research, or another quantitative field

•Significant experience leading applied AI, decision intelligence, optimisation, or analytical platform work in complex operational domains

•Strong understanding of optimisation and modelling principles and how algorithms support real planning problems

•Experience improving planning, routing, scheduling, or network optimisation through heuristics, analytics, or AI-based enhancements

•Strong Python skills and comfort working closely with software and data engineering teams

•Proven ability to lead experimentation, validate model performance, and convert technical ideas into business-relevant capabilities

•Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders

Preferred qualifications:

•Experience in logistics, supply chain, shipping, transportation, or another optimisation-heavy industry

•Exposure to large-scale network design, routing, fleet planning, cargo flow optimisation, or similar decision systems

•Experience using AI or ML to improve optimisation performance, such as learning-augmented algorithms, surrogate models, search guidance, or reinforcement learning

•Experience working across research, prototyping, and productionisation of optimisation methods

Leadership expectations:

This role is expected to lead through others. The Principal AI Engineer should create the technical direction, decision framework, and quality standards for a broader team of optimisation, analytics, and AI specialists. The role should not be framed as a lone architect writing models end to end. It should be framed as the senior leader who sets the optimisation intelligence agenda and ensures that specialist work compounds into a coherent capability.

About the role

Maersk Air Cargo is seeking an Airworthiness Review Staff / Technical Records Engineer to cover the combined responsibilities of Airworthiness Review Staff (ARS) and Technical Records Engineer in a single integrated role.

The position plays a key role in ensuring continued airworthiness, regulatory compliance, and the integrity of aircraft records, in accordance with EASA Part‑CAMO and the company’s Continuing Airworthiness Management Exposition (CAME). The successful candidate will combine Airworthiness Review authority with ownership of technical records while actively contributing to aircraft transitions, fleet projects, and continuous improvement initiatives across the organisation.

This is a fully office-based role, requiring on-site presence five days per week at the advertised location.

Key Responsibilities

Airworthiness Review Staff (ARS) Responsibilities

• Perform Airworthiness Reviews (documentary and physical) in accordance with approved CAME procedures

• Issue, recommend, and manage Airworthiness Review Certificates (ARC), including extensions where applicable

• Ensure airworthiness reviews are conducted & verify continuing airworthiness compliance

• Coordinate findings, observations, and corrective actions with Engineering, Planning, and Compliance Monitoring

• Provide airworthiness expertise during audits, authority oversight, and internal compliance activities

Technical Records / Records Engineer Responsibilities

• Own the integrity and quality of continuing airworthiness records across the Maersk Air Cargo fleet, supporting operational excellence and regulatory compliance.

• Ensure correct structure and traceability of records

• Drive data quality and consistency across CAMO systems, digital records platforms, and archival solutions, contributing to the continued development of Maersk Air Cargo's airworthiness management environment.

• Participate in aircraft lease‑in and lease‑out projects, fleet transitions, and changes of aircraft registration as part of a dedicated cross‑functional team, ensuring successful records integration and regulatory compliance.

• Act as a key contributor during audits, regulatory oversight activities, and aircraft reviews, ensuring records are inspection-ready and support efficient compliance demonstration.

• Support the development and optimisation of technical records processes, digital tools, and airworthiness data management practices as the fleet and organisation continue to grow.

Qualifications and Experience

• Eligible for approval as Airworthiness Review Staff under EASA Part‑CAMO

• EASA Part 66 AML or relevant engineering degree

• A minimum of 5 years of experience in continuing airworthiness.

• Proven experience within continuing airworthiness management and technical records

• Strong knowledge of:

• EASA Part‑CAMO / Part‑M

• Airworthiness Review and ARC processes

• Maintenance Programs and AD management

• Experience with CAMO IT systems (e.g. Flydocs, CAMP, or equivalent)

• Highly structured, detail‑oriented, and audit‑experienced

• Able to work independently while collaborating effectively across Engineering, Planning, and Compliance functions
